title: BC 802: Definitions
officialText:
802.1 Definitions.

FLAME SPREAD.

FLAME SPREAD INDEX.

INTERIOR FINISH.

INTERIOR FLOOR FINISH.

INTERIOR FLOOR-WALL BASE.

INTERIOR WALL AND CEILING FINISH.

SMOKE-DEVELOPED INDEX.
